response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Chikungunya virus infection'. Between C and D, option D is more specific, including 'bilateral stromal keratouveitis' which aligns better with the vignette's description of 'bilateral blurred vision', 'stromal immune ring formation', 'keratic precipitates', and 'mild anterior chamber reaction' (uveitis). Between A and B, option B is more specific, including 'immune-mediated interstitial keratitis' which aligns better with the vignette's description of 'stromal immune ring formation' and 'localized anterior stromal infiltrate'.
